item.title: The Year of the Agent: What Recent Attacks Revealed in Q4 2025 (and What It Means for 2026)
item.description:
Author: Lakera Team
Date: December 17, 2025
Tags: ["AI Security", "Cybersecurity Threats", "Machine Learning Attacks", "Data Privacy", "AI Agent Vulnerabilities"]
Summary:
  • Attackers quickly adapted to new AI agent capabilities in Q4 2025.
  • Common attacks included system-prompt extraction and content-safety bypasses.
  • Role-play and obfuscation were key techniques used by attackers.
  • Early agent-specific attacks targeted confidential data and hidden instructions.
  • Indirect attacks manipulated external context with fewer assumptions.
  • The study stresses urgent AI agent security improvements for 2026.

item.title: Cybersecurity 2026 | The Year Ahead in AI, Adversaries, and Global Change
item.description:
Author: Christopher Budd
Date: N/A
Tags: ["Cybersecurity", "Artificial Intelligence", "Geopolitics", "Cloud Security", "Threat Intelligence"]
Summary:
  • Cybersecurity is rapidly evolving due to AI and geopolitical shifts.
  • AI enhances both defense and attacks in cybersecurity.
  • State-sponsored threats target critical infrastructure globally.
  • Zero trust and identity security are vital for protection.
  • Cloud security in hybrid environments faces new challenges.
  • Collaboration and AI-driven tools are key for future readiness.

item.title: CyberVolk Returns | Flawed VolkLocker, Brings New Features With Growing Pains
item.description:
Author: Jon DiMaggio
Date: N/A
Tags: ["Cybersecurity", "Ransomware", "Malware Analysis", "Threat Intelligence", "Data Protection"]
Summary:
  • VolkLocker ransomware operated by CyberVolk has returned with new features.
  • It still has significant flaws and coding errors.
  • The latest version has improved encryption and communication protocols.
  • Bugs may allow victims to recover data without paying.
  • CyberVolk targets organizations globally with ransom demands.
  • SentinelOne advises strong endpoint protection and regular backups.

Tags: ["AI Image Generation", "Brand Style Transfer", "Machine Learning Benchmarks", "Computer Vision"]

item.title: OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Application 2026: Understanding the Risks of Agents and Tools
item.description:
Author: Giskard Team
Date: N/A
Tags: ["Cybersecurity", "Agentic Applications", "Autonomous Systems", "Data Security", "Software Risk Management"]
Summary:
  • OWASP released the Top 10 security risks for agentic applications in 2026.
  • These apps make autonomous decisions and face unique threats.
  • Key risks include data poisoning, unauthorized access, and privacy violations.
  • The guide stresses monitoring, ethical compliance, and collaboration.
  • Developers should follow best practices to secure these systems.
